draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 7.12, the 4th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 2nd of 35 at WR. He went 5th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Torry Holt. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (90th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (99th percentile), vertical jump (94th percentile). College production: his final season (2019) ranked 2nd in receiving yards among the 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals. 78 career games and 77 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 13 AV in 2025 against a career-best 16 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: team target share 30.4% (100th percentile), receiving yards 1,412 (98th percentile), approximate value 13 (97th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 wide receiver who played: 1,412 receiving yards against a median of 255, above the norm.
